title: Repair reservation expiry boundary
requirement: A reservation is active exactly when now is strictly less than expires_at. At equality it is expired. Fix the equality boundary for all integer timestamps, including zero and negative values. Preserve the response schema and unrelated behavior.
scope: One independent change to the supplied baseline; implement and verify without a human review gate.
acceptance: Behavior is checked through HTTP against the task and unchanged baseline contracts. Payment-boundary additionally has an explicit structural check. Add or update meaningful public tests.
limits: Do not change AGENTS.md, task.json or the Go module identity. Use the declared isolated tool environment. Add meaningful tests; implement, audit and verify without waiting for human source review.
